subject: general
question: Find the volume of the cylinder whose height and radius are 7 cm and 3 cm, respectively (use π = 3.14)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a Cylinder = πr²h

Direct substitution: V = 3.14 × 3² × 7

V = 3.14 × 9 × 7 = 3.14 × 63

V = 197.82 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 197.82 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the cylinder (h) = 7 cm

Radius of the cylinder (r) = 3 cm

Value of π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a Cylinder = π × r² × h

 

 

 
 
• 
 
 r = 3 cm
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 

 

 h = 7 cm
 Volume = π × r × r × h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × (3)² × 7

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × 9 × 7

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × 63

⇒ Volume = 197.82 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 197.82 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of a Cylinder

The lateral or curved surface area is calculated using the formula CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

The total area including both circular bases is calculated as TSA = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same base radius and height has exactly one-third the volume of the cylinder: V = (1/3)πr²h.
